papers.title: Subwavelength registration of skull-compensating acoustic holograms via nonlinear parametric array feedback
papers.summary: Uses nonlinear parametric-array feedback as a surrogate signal to align skull-compensating acoustic holograms at subwavelength precision, supported by simulations and ex vivo experiments; focus is hologram registration rather than image reconstruction.
